summary: James Bond 007 entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: 007: Quantum of Solace
entries.definitive_edition: Legally owned PC/HD-console branch with delisting and multiplayer state documented

emulation.emulator: RPCS3/Xenia/Dolphin/PCSX2/DeSmuME only for console variant comparison
emulation.notes: Native owned PC route preferred when available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Owned PC build with exact patch/offline-service state documented

primary.version: Owned PC build; delisted Activision Bond route
primary.why: The PC/HD-console version is the highest-fidelity shooter route, but Activision Bond titles were delisted after license expiration. A legal owned PC disc/digital copy is the capture route; PS2, Wii, and DS versions differ materially and must be labeled if used.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally owned PC copy where available. Record disc/digital source, patch/GFWL/offline-profile state, resolution/fixes, controller, campaign difficulty, multiplayer availability, and whether PS2/Wii/DS variants were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for platform comparison or if PC ownership is unavailable.
secondary.why: PC has the strongest capture/fix ceiling.
They are not the same fidelity branch as the PC/HD-console shooter.

all_releases.fidelity: Main FPS route, now delisted from normal digital sale.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity branch when legally owned.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The best route is delisted/owned-copy dependent, and platform branches differ.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record license/delisting state; do not substitute later James Bond games.

entries.title: 007 First Light
entries.definitive_edition: 007 First Light on Windows PC, current patch

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulation branch.

primary.version: 007 First Light PC (Steam / Epic Games Store)
primary.why: PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S launched together with the same content, so PC is the fidelity pick (uncapped settings and resolution against fixed console targets). The Switch 2 version arrived later and is the lowest-fidelity branch.
primary.how_to_play: Play 007 First Light on Windows PC. Record storefront/build and patch version, graphics settings, resolution/aspect, difficulty, and mission progress. Note that the game shipped after a two-month delay from its original March window, so early-patch behaviour may differ from later.

all_releases.fidelity: Highest settings/resolution ceiling; day-one content parity.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity, same content as console.
skip: no exclusive content; lower ceiling than PC.
skip: no exclusive content; lower ceiling than PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable route, released after the other platforms.
all_releases.reason: skip: lowest fidelity branch and a later build; portable-only benefit.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No conflict: PC has the same content as the day-one console versions at a higher ceiling.

entries.remaster_caveats: Recently released after a delay — re-check the patch state before treating performance or balance observations as permanent.
